kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتكأكأ (form IIq)
# نَتَكَأْكَأُ (natakaʔkaʔu) /na.ta.kaʔ.ka.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# نَتَكَأْكَأَ (natakaʔkaʔa) /na.ta.kaʔ.ka.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# نَتَكَأْكَأْ (natakaʔkaʔ) /na.ta.kaʔ.kaʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
